put.description:
Updates a Unit.

This endpoint replaces the stored Unit rather than patching it. Retrieve the Unit first, apply your changes to the object you got back, and send the whole object. Any property you leave out of the body is cleared, including the nested "listing" and "rentalApplicationListing" objects.

Two properties behave in ways that are easy to get wrong:

* "addressSameAsProperty" defaults to true when omitted. If the Unit has its own address, send it explicitly as false or the address will be replaced by the property address.
* "rentalApplicationListing.activeListing" is forced to true whenever "listing.activeListing" or "listing.companySiteListingOnly" is true. A Unit that is publicly listed always accepts rental applications, so applications cannot be closed on their own.

To take a Unit off the market entirely, set "listing.activeListing", "listing.companySiteListingOnly" and "rentalApplicationListing.activeListing" all to false in the same request.

requestBody.description: The complete Unit object, as returned by Retrieve a Unit, with your changes applied.

addressSameAsProperty.description: If set to true, the address of this unit will be the same as the property it is linked to and the value in the "address" property will be ignored.

baths.description: The number of bathrooms. Fractions are allowed, for example 2.5.

size.description: The size of the unit in square feet.

marketRent.description: The internal market rent of the unit, used in reports such as the rent roll. The rent advertised in a listing is listing.rent.

listing.description: The advertised listing of the unit: whether it is published to listing partners or the company site, with the advertised rent, deposit, date available and contact. It is separate from rentalApplicationListing, which controls whether the unit accepts rental applications.

contact.description: Reference to the User Id who is the listing contact person. The user's contact information (Phone number, Email address) will be posted

companySiteListingOnly.description: When true the Unit is published only to your company site and not to the syndicated listing partners. It still counts as listed, so it keeps rental applications open.

rentalApplicationListing.description: Controls whether the Unit accepts rental applications. Forced active while "listing.activeListing" or "listing.companySiteListingOnly" is true.

post.description: Creates a complete, ready-to-use lease in a single call - property, units, term, dates, security deposits, one-time and recurring charges and credits, and tenant move-in - inside one transaction. Tenants may be passed as existing ids or as new-tenant objects created inline and de-duplicated by email within the company. If any part fails, nothing is persisted.

end.description: Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for an open-ended schedule.

start.description: Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the lease start date when omitted.

fullLeaseCreateNewTenant.title: fullLeaseCreateNewTenant
fullLeaseCreateNewTenant.description: Creates a tenant inline, inside the same transaction. De-duplicated by email within the company - the address is matched case-insensitively against existing tenants and stored trimmed and lowercased.

name.description: Defaults to the tenant names when omitted.

units.description: One or more units on the property.

end.description: Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Required when term is Fixed; ignored when term is AtWill.

tenants.description: Each entry is either an existing tenant id or a new-tenant object to create inline.

createdTenantIds.description: Ids of tenants created inline by this request. Empty when every tenant already existed.

reference.description: Read Only

end.description: Required if term == AtWill. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

rolloverToAtWill.description: If set to true, the lease will automatically rollover to "At Will" (Month to Month) at the end of the fixed term.

units.description: An array of Unit Ids for this lease

parameters.name: filter_DefaultAccountFor
parameters.description: Returns the account this company has designated for a given purpose. The chart of accounts is per-company, so account ids differ between companies - resolve these once per company and cache the ids rather than matching on account names.

parameters.name: filter_leaseChargeItem
parameters.description: Return only lease charge items - the catalog of things a tenant can be charged for

parameters.name: filter_parentAccount
parameters.description: Return only the direct children of this account

parameters.name: filter_ancestorAccount
parameters.description: Return every account beneath this one at any depth. Use this to resolve a charge to its top-level category when a company files charges under sub-accounts - sub-accounts do not carry a filter_DefaultAccountFor value, only the top-level anchor does.

active.description: Whether the property is active. A property cannot be made inactive while it has active units, and a unit cannot be made active while its property is inactive.

numActiveUnits.description: The number of units in this property with active set to true, whether or not they are listed.

settings.description: Per-property settings. settings.defaultAccounts.bank_operating is the operating account for this property and is the correct value to use as depositToAccount when recording a payment. A portfolio can run a different bank account per property, so do not resolve one account per company and reuse it; the company-level default is only the fallback. The groups that can appear, once they have been set, are tenantPortal, lateFeesPolicy, rentersInsurance, paymentAllocations, recurringTransactions, defaultAccounts, propertyReserve, managementFees, mailingTemplates, paymentInstructions, convenienceFeesPolicy, creditCardConvenienceFeesPolicy, returnedPaymentFeesSettings, rentReminders, tenantRequests and showings.

get.description:
Retrieves a list of all lease tenants, meaning, tenants that have been associated with an active list.

This endpoint includes additional information related to the lease for each tenant in DoorLoop, with the full Tenant object included as well.

If a tenant is associated with multiple leases, the tenant will appear in the results here once for each lease it is associated with.

parameters.name: filter_status
parameters.description: Occupancy status, derived from move-in and move-out dates rather than lease status - so CURRENT includes tenants in eviction, on notice, holdover and pay-or-quit. This is the recommended way to list current occupants.

name.description: The display name for this tenant

units.description: An array of unit Ids for this tenant

status.description: The current status of this tenant

assignedToUser.description: The User Id this Prospect is assigned to

interests.description: Represents all the properties and/or units this prospect is interested moving into

Key.description: Bearer token. Create a key under Settings -> API access; it is a JWT. Example: `Authorization: Bearer eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.<payload>.<signature>`

reversedPayment.description: If this payment was returned, will reference the returned payment

linkedCharges.description: Charges this payment was applied against, with the amount applied to each. Populated whether the application was automatic (autoApplyPaymentOnCharges) or manual.

linkedCredits.description: Credits this payment was applied against, with the amount applied to each

ePayInfo.description: Present for payments processed by DoorLoop. method is the only way to distinguish a card payment from a bank payment - paymentMethod: EPAY covers both rails.

paymentOrigin.description: Where the payment was initiated from

depositEntry.description: The deposit journal entry this payment belongs to, if any. depositStatus is derived from its presence rather than being set directly.

paymentMethods.description: Lists all possible payment methods that can be used in payable and receivable transactions. Use EFT to record an electronic funds transfer that was collected outside DoorLoop. EPAY is reserved for payments processed through DoorLoop's own merchant account and requires a nested ePayInfo object.
